corrections: wn30-n-04709253: The definition only restates difficulty as being difficult, without explaining effort or obstacles.
wn30-n-04735233: The definition only restates variability as being subject to variation, without independent explanatory content.
wn30-n-04756172: The definition repeats probable and conflates the likelihood property with a probable event, without independently explaining either sense.
wn30-n-04806316: The definition only restates irreproducibility as being unreproducible, without explaining inability to repeat a result.
wn30-n-04819694: The definition only restates expressiveness as being expressive, without explaining the conveyed emotion or meaning.
wn30-n-04834605: The selfishness gloss requires stinginess, although disregard for others in pursuit of personal welfare need not concern giving or possessions.
wn30-n-04857083: The definition requires not showing fear; courage can coexist with expressed fear.
wn30-n-04878861: The definition only restates infidelity as being unfaithful, without explaining the relationship or breached commitment.
wn30-n-04884072: The definition only restates inhibition as being inhibited, without explaining restraint or suppression.
wn30-n-04904352: The serenity gloss requires freedom from emotion, although calm dispositions can include emotions; it conflates tranquility with emotional absence.
wn30-n-04930307: The definition only restates fit as the manner in which something fits, without explaining compatibility or dimensions.

wn30-n-04935003: The gloss restricts viscosity to liquids, although gases also have viscosity; unsuitable as a general physical definition. See https://www1.grc.nasa.gov/beginners-guide-to-aeronautics/gas-properties-definitions/.

wn30-n-04975122: The gloss defines hue solely by dominant wavelength, which does not exist for purple stimuli; it presents a restricted colorimetric case as general. See https://ies.org/definitions/dominant-wavelength-of-a-color-stimulus/.
wn30-n-04977561: The skin-color gloss includes bruising as an unexplained cause of pallor, conflating discoloration with loss of color; remove this imprecise historical medical formulation.
wn30-n-05008227: The gloss combines maleness and masculinity under properties characteristic of male sex, obscuring the distinction between sex characteristics and gendered traits.

wn30-n-05015117: The cold gloss says absence of heat, conflating relative low temperature with absence of thermal energy or heat transfer. See https://www.nist.gov/si-redefinition/kelvin/kelvin-thermodynamic-temperature.

wn30-n-05028700: Comparatively small weight is not weightlessness; weightlessness concerns absence of apparent supported weight, including free fall. See https://www.nasa.gov/centers-and-facilities/glenn/what-is-microgravity/.
wn30-n-05055974: The definition merely restates the headword as mortal without explaining susceptibility to death.

wn30-n-05064827: The mathematical symmetry gloss only describes reflection in a line or plane, excluding rotational and other symmetries; an unjustified restriction in this unrestricted mathematical sense.
wn30-n-05091770: The favorable-cases ratio requires equally likely finite outcomes; the unrestricted probability gloss omits this condition. See https://math.mit.edu/~sheffield/440/Lecture5.pdf.

wn30-n-05099796: The radiation gloss defines intensity as an amount of energy, omitting the time and area dependence needed to distinguish intensity from energy. See https://iupac.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/05/IUPAC-GB3-2012-2ndPrinting-PDFsearchable.pdf.
wn30-n-05108947: The definition only restates increase as the amount by which something increases, without explaining the positive difference between quantities.
wn30-n-05143300: The gloss embeds a dated usage prescription favoring in behalf over on behalf for benefit, rather than providing a clear standalone lexical sense.
